title: Guide symbol in a macrostep configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be an input word over the schedule alphabet, and let $\mathrm{base}$ be a schedule-machine configuration on $x$. For any optional control phase $q$ and integers $u,g$, the symbol read on the guide tape in the macrostep configuration with phase $q$, unary head at $u$, and guide head at $g$ is the content of the base guide tape at coordinate $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite binary Turing machine
$x$ is an input word over the schedule alphabet
replaced:
In every macrostep configuration with guide head at $g$, the symbol read on the guide
tape is the base configuration's guide tape content at coordinate $g$.
